_doc: Ground truth for T2. Set A = intent queries about the PRODUCT (build/) - the concepts the task named; expected symbols verified by reading build/*.py. Set B = intent queries whose implementation lives in the INDEXED part of the repo (hooks/, benchmark/, scripts/, install.*). type: concept|symbol|code. expected: list of [file, name]; a hit = any returned row whose file matches AND whose name equals the expected name or ends with '.'+name.
